analysis.reason:
RSI 31.4에서 49.5로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인.
MACD 히스토그램도 -51272.9768에서 2279.0884로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호.
직전 3거래일 연속 관망 후, 5일 저가(1,171,000) 대비 5일 고가(1,495,000)가 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴 형성.
analysis.reasonEn:
RSI rose from 31.4 to 49.5, confirming exit from oversold territory.
MACD histogram improved from -51272.9768 to 2279.0884, signaling bottoming.
The 5-day low (1,171,000) to 5-day high (1,495,000) formed a Higher Low pattern, breaking the 3-day wait-and-see stance.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 1,487,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 1,320,600) / SMA20 (KRW 1,489,500) / SMA50 (KRW 1,628,668): trading near the middle band, mixed short-to-medium term trend.
· Position vs SMA100 (KRW 1,849,999) / SMA200 (KRW 1,484,489): below long-term trend, indicating bearish pressure.
· 52-week position (39.7%): high relative to historical lows, significant pullback from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.4→49.5): exiting oversold, entering neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-51272.9768→2279.0884): improving after bearish convergence, signaling bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band KRW 1,489,500): wide band width at 60.92%, trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 1,373,000): confirmed support based on Pivot S1 (KRW 1,153,667) and SMA200 (KRW 1,484,489).
· Swing resistance (KRW 1,890,000): potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal, potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.36x): movement is gaining momentum, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI exit from oversold and MACD improvement confirmed, a zone for considering entry.
